description: Champion + event context (aux family se-aux-event-v1, same capture's full binary listing): log event size, neg-risk overround (sum of quoted sibling mids - 1) and its quoted share, own normalisation gap, own mid rank and largest sibling mid, siblings' summed Gamma 1h/1d changes (own excluded). Trains only when every labelled capture of the target's window has the event table (comparability with the champion's row set); never predicts without it.
